vibrational-generation.en:
## Structure generation without a formula

The default OpenMolSpec route takes only calculated IR and Raman intensities. A shift estimator fitted on 11,632 connectivities predicts H and C shift counts and positions for the frozen structure decoder. On 24 development molecules it recovered 3 structures at rank 1. Updating the decoder output weights recovered 0/24, as did the frozen decoder with empty NMR inputs. On a separate 24-molecule confirmation set, estimated shifts recovered 2/24 at rank 1, 5/24 in the first three and 6/24 in the first five. The frozen baseline recovered 0/24 at all three cutoffs. All scores compare canonical molecular structures without stereochemistry.

```python
from openmolspec.model import Vib2Mol
model = Vib2Mol(root=openspec_root, python=model_python)
result = model.predict({"ir": ir, "raman": raman}, top_k=5)
candidates = result["candidates"]
estimated_ppm = result["estimated_shifts_ppm"]
```

The example figure and original evaluation table below use the earlier empty-NMR decoder. The current benchmark excludes all 13,190 train and validation connectivities used for fitting the shift estimator.

## Xinyu Lu’s released dual-spectrum model

The released VB-Mols MMM decoder takes IR, Raman and an independently supplied molecular formula. With 10 beams, the first candidate matched 24 of 24 sampled VB-Mols test structures and 0 of 24 sampled OpenMolSpec structures. Both panels use canonical SMILES with stereochemistry removed. [Author’s implementation](https://github.com/X1nyuLu/vib2mol)

```python
from openmolspec.model import Vib2Mol

model = Vib2Mol(root=openspec_root, python=model_python)
result = model.predict_native(
    {"ir": ir, "raman": raman}, formula=formula, checkout=vib2mol_checkout
)
```
vibrational-generation.zh:
## 无分子式的结构生成

默认接口只需计算得到的 IR 和 Raman。位移估计模型在 11,632 个连通结构上拟合，预测氢、碳位移的数量和位置，再由冻结的解码器生成候选。在 24 个开发分子上，第一名命中 3/24；仅微调解码器输出层和直接留空 NMR 输入都为 0/24。另取 24 个独立分子，估计位移后第一名命中 2/24，前三名 5/24，前五名 6/24；留空 NMR 的原模型三项均为 0/24。结构匹配采用去除立体化学后的规范 SMILES。

```python
from openmolspec.model import Vib2Mol
model = Vib2Mol(root=openspec_root, python=model_python)
result = model.predict({"ir": ir, "raman": raman}, top_k=5)
candidates = result["candidates"]
estimated_ppm = result["estimated_shifts_ppm"]
```

下方示例图和原始评测表展示留空 NMR 的旧模型。当前 benchmark 已排除位移估计模型拟合及选参用到的全部 13,190 个连通结构。

## Xinyu Lu 发布的双谱模型

VB-Mols 的 MMM 解码器接受 IR、Raman 和独立提供的分子式。使用 10 条 beam，在作者 VB-Mols 测试集抽取的 24 个结构中，第一名命中 24 个；在 OpenMolSpec 抽取的另 24 个结构中命中 0 个。两组均按忽略立体化学的规范 SMILES 比较，覆盖的化学空间不同。下方原有案例使用无需分子式的 OpenMolSpec 解码器。[作者实现](https://github.com/X1nyuLu/vib2mol)

```python
from openmolspec.model import Vib2Mol

model = Vib2Mol(root=openspec_root, python=model_python)
result = model.predict_native(
    {"ir": ir, "raman": raman}, formula=formula, checkout=vib2mol_checkout
)
```

nmr-assignment.en:
## Experimental ground truth

The frozen NMRNet assignment was scored on a structure-held-out sample of 256 NMRShiftDB connectivities per nucleus. For ¹H, 1,289 of 2,009 observed shifts across 280 spectra were assigned to the labelled or symmetry-equivalent attached heavy atom (64.2%). For ¹³C, 2,131 of 2,576 shifts across 275 spectra matched a labelled carbon site (82.7%). Unmatched peaks and conformer failures count against accuracy. The upstream checkpoint's exposure to these structures is unverified.
nmr-assignment.zh:
## 实测位点真值

在按连通结构划分的 NMRShiftDB 测试数据中，每种核各抽 256 种分子。¹H 的 280 张谱共 2,009 个实测峰，正确指认 1,289 个（64.2%）。¹³C 的 275 张谱共 2,576 个实测峰，正确指认 2,131 个（82.7%）。¹H 按所连重原子计分，接受拓扑对称等价位点；漏配和构象生成失败计入分母。上游 NMRNet 权重的训练集重叠尚未核实。

ms-annotation-magma.en:
## Expanded spectrum benchmark

MAGMa annotated 64 MassSpecGym test spectra at 10 ppm with a 24-heavy-atom limit. The benchmark checked 70,498 candidate fragment mappings against the parent structure. At least one candidate matched the mass of 49.80% of observed peaks. Fragment identities require independent labels to score structural correctness.
ms-annotation-magma.zh:
## 扩展的谱图评测

MAGMa 对 64 张 MassSpecGym 测试谱运行注释，质量容差为 10 ppm，最多 24 个重原子。共核对 70,498 个候选碎片与母体结构的原子和键映射。49.80% 的实测峰有质量匹配的候选，碎片结构正确率仍需独立的碎片标签。

nmr-solvent_transfer.en:
## Expanded paired reference benchmark

All eligible reviewed pairs gave 46 distinct molecular connectivities and 442 atom-shift pairs. With the query connectivity excluded from the reference search, ¹H MAE was 0.151 ppm versus 0.159 ppm for retaining the source shift (159 atoms). For ¹³C the corresponding values were 1.144 and 1.238 ppm (283 atoms). Seven pairs lacked an independent reference for their solvent combination.
nmr-solvent_transfer.zh:
## 扩展的跨溶剂实测配对

对已审核参考库中可独立预测的配对全部评测，共 46 种分子、442 对原子位移。参考检索排除查询分子。¹H 的 MAE 为 0.151 ppm，直接沿用原位移为 0.159 ppm（159 个原子）；¹³C 分别为 1.144 和 1.238 ppm（283 个原子）。另有 7 个配对的溶剂组合缺少独立参考。

nmr-retrieval-hc-s2m.en:
## Generate alternatives after retrieval

When the shortlist has no convincing match, choose **Generate alternatives** below the retrieval results and enter an independently established molecular formula. The generator uses the ¹H and ¹³C records submitted for that search. The original ranked list stays visible alongside the generated candidates.
nmr-retrieval-hc-s2m.zh:
## 检索后继续解谱

候选都不合适时，在检索结果下选择 **Generate alternatives** 并输入独立获得的分子式。生成模型沿用提交检索时的 ¹H 和 ¹³C 谱，原候选及其检索排名保留在页面上。生成结构来自模型的解码结果，仍需用实测谱确认。

vibrational-gap-ir.en:
## Vibrational-only regression

With IR and no NMR, the software selects a regressor fitted to these vibrational inputs. A new connectivity-disjoint split of the packaged theoretical spectra contains 11,568 training, 1,651 validation and 3,381 test molecules. Test MAE is 0.382 eV versus 0.749 eV for the training mean. The original 128 queries were separately reserved and give 0.428 eV MAE. The historical figures below show the four-channel checkpoint with inputs masked.
vibrational-gap-ir.zh:
## 仅用振动谱的回归模型

输入 IR 且没有 NMR 时，软件使用专门训练的谱到能隙回归模型。在 OpenMolSpec 理论谱上重新按连通结构划分，训练 11,568 种分子，验证 1,651 种，测试 3,381 种。测试 MAE 为 0.382 eV，训练均值对照为 0.749 eV。历史 128 个查询单独留出，回测 MAE 为 0.428 eV。下方原始图表记录四通道模型屏蔽输入后的表现。

vibrational-generation-hc.en:
## Ordering generated candidates

The decoder keeps the first occurrence of each valid canonical structure. The SDK returns that order and reports the matching model’s probability, beam rank and ITM rank for each candidate. Pass `ranking="itm"` to reproduce the original matching-head order. On the 64-query replay, the default has 48 first-place and 57 top-three hits. ITM alone gives 44 and 54. On 24 additional structures excluded from the 64-query replay, both orderings achieved 14/24 top-1 and 19/24 top-3.
vibrational-generation-hc.zh:
## 生成候选的顺序

解码时对有效规范结构去重，保留第一次出现的位置。SDK 按该顺序展示候选，并返回 ITM 匹配概率、beam 排名和 ITM 排名。传入 `ranking="itm"` 可复现原始匹配头的顺序。同一组 64 个查询中，默认首位命中 48 个、前三命中 57 个，单用 ITM 顺序分别命中 44 个和 54 个。 另取与上述 64 个结构去重的 24 个结构，两种排序的 Top-1 都是 14/24，Top-3 都是 19/24。

vibrational-retrieval.en:
## Retrieval from 1,024 candidates

Using Xinyu Lu’s published VB-Mols dual-spectrum matcher, with the reference present, embedding retrieval ranked it first for 1/64 queries. ITM rescoring of the top 16 gave 1/64. Exhaustive ITM scoring over all 1,024 candidates gave 0/8 on the prespecified first eight queries. With the project checkpoint and only IR and Raman supplied, the corresponding counts were 0/64, 0/64 and 0/2. Models shared identical queries and candidates. The pool contained same-formula distractors for 61 of the 64 queries.
vibrational-retrieval.zh:
## 1,024 候选结构评测

使用Xinyu Lu 的 VB-Mols 双谱模型，每个查询的真结构均在库中。嵌入检索第一名命中 1/64，对前 16 名用 ITM 重排后命中 1/64。在预先选定的前 8 个查询上，对全库逐一做 ITM 打分，第一名命中 0/8。将同一查询输入项目的四谱模型，只提供 IR 和 Raman 时，嵌入检索命中 0/64，前 16 名重排命中 0/64，逐一全库打分命中 0/2。各模型共用查询和候选，其中 61 个查询有同分子式干扰结构。
